rationale: Steven is building TinyHumans AI, an open-source personal AI agent with brain-inspired memory systems, and explicitly prioritizes UI-first, private, and local approaches to consumer AI—areas where an Educator and Technology Professional could provide valuable perspective on real-world usability and adoption. While E's specific background couldn't be verified, the complementary skill sets (Steven's deep technical founding and engineering chops paired with E's educational and technology professional experience) create potential for knowledge exchange in bringing AI products to broader audiences.
intro_message: Steven Enamakel, meet E Agor — both working at the intersection of AI and making technology accessible; would be great for you two to explore how brain-inspired AI and educational tech might intersect.
